1.caption: The start/finish straight rising towards the Turn 1 hill: the road climbs about 41 m to the crest, where drivers brake for the tight uphill left-hand hairpin.
1.author: Lars Plougmann

1.caption: Kevin Magnussen's McLaren exiting Turn 1 during the 2014 US Grand Prix, past the crest of the hairpin and heading down towards Turn 2.
1.author: John Champion

2.caption: The field streaming downhill through Turn 2, the sweeping right-hander after the Turn 1 hairpin, at the 2013 United States Grand Prix.
2.author: Larry D. Moore

3.caption: The esses viewed from the hillside during the 2016 US Grand Prix: Turns 3, 4, 5 and 6 snake left-right-left-right through the Maggotts/Becketts-style sequence.
3.author: el_ave

3.caption: Aerial view of the 'Ess Curves', the fast Turns 3-6 sequence below the Turn 1 hill, photographed in June 2015.
3.author: formulanone

4.caption: Turn 4 is the second element of the esses visible in this view of Turns 3-6 from the 2016 US Grand Prix.
4.author: el_ave

5.caption: Turn 5 is the third element of the esses visible in this view of Turns 3-6 from the 2016 US Grand Prix.
5.author: el_ave

6.caption: Turn 6 closes the esses sequence visible in this view of Turns 3-6 from the 2016 US Grand Prix.
6.author: el_ave

8.caption: Turns 8 and 9 during the 2016 US Grand Prix: the right-left flick at the end of the first sector that leads onto the run to Turn 10.
8.author: el_ave

9.caption: Turn 9 is the right-hand half of the Turn 8-9 flick shown here at the 2016 US Grand Prix.
9.author: el_ave

10.caption: Construction-era view looking into Turn 10, the fast downhill left kink, with the paddock building and main grandstand in the background (June 2012).
10.author: Larry D. Moore

11.caption: Turn 11, the tight left hairpin at the far end of the circuit, nearing completion in June 2012.
11.author: Larry D. Moore

11.caption: Sebastian Vettel slowing to about 70 mph for the Turn 11 hairpin at the inaugural 2012 race, with eventual winner Lewis Hamilton close behind.
11.author: Earl McGehee from Austin, TX, USA

12.caption: Panorama from the Turn 12 grandstand in 2012: the end of the back straight and the heavy-braking left-hander, with the Observation Tower and stadium section beyond.
12.author: Patrick from Moretown, VT, United States

14.caption: Looking down from the top of the Observation Tower onto the amphitheatre beside the stadium section; the Turn 12-15 track runs along the left edge of the frame.
14.author: Larry D. Moore

15.caption: A car lifting a wheel over the kerb at Turn 15 during the 2016 US Grand Prix.
15.author: pedrik

15.caption: Opening lap of the 2016 US Grand Prix: Palmer, Ericsson, Grosjean, Ocon and Nasr still tightly bunched through Turn 15.
15.author: pedrik

19.caption: Turn 19, the fast left-hander after the Turn 16-18 multi-apex right, at the 2016 US Grand Prix.
19.author: el_ave
